description: This file defines the xajaxResponse class, which creates XML responses for AJAX operations in PHP, supporting various commands like assign, append, replace, alert, redirect, and more.

classes.name: xajaxResponse
classes.description: A class for constructing XML responses to AJAX requests, supporting commands like assign, append, alert, redirect, and more.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the response with character encoding and output entity settings.

methods.name: setCharEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the response.

methods.name: outputEntitiesOn
methods.description: Enables conversion of special characters to HTML entities.

methods.name: outputEntitiesOff
methods.description: Disables conversion of special characters to HTML entities.

methods.name: addConfirmCommands
methods.description: Adds a confirmation dialog command to the response.

methods.name: addAssign
methods.description: Adds an assign command to modify an element's attribute.

methods.name: addAppend
methods.description: Adds an append command to add data to an element's attribute.

methods.name: addPrepend
methods.description: Adds a prepend command to add data at the beginning of an element's attribute.

methods.name: addReplace
methods.description: Adds a replace command to search and replace data in an element's attribute.

methods.name: addClear
methods.description: Adds a command to clear an element's attribute.

methods.name: addAlert
methods.description: Adds an alert dialog command.

methods.name: addRedirect
methods.description: Adds a redirect command to navigate to a URL.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript code execution command.

methods.name: addScriptCall
methods.description: Adds a command to call a JavaScript function with arguments.

methods.name: addRemove
methods.description: Adds a command to remove an HTML element.

methods.name: addCreate
methods.description: Adds a command to create a new HTML element.

methods.name: addInsert
methods.description: Adds a command to insert a new element before a specified element.

methods.name: addInsertAfter
methods.description: Adds a command to insert a new element after a specified element.

methods.name: addCreateInput
methods.description: Adds a command to create a new input element inside a parent.

methods.name: addInsertInput
methods.description: Adds a command to insert a new input element before a specified element.

methods.name: addInsertInputAfter
methods.description: Adds a command to insert a new input element after a specified element.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds an event handler to an element.

methods.name: addHandler
methods.description: Adds an event handler function to an element.

methods.name: addRemoveHandler
methods.description: Removes an event handler from an element.

methods.name: addIncludeScript
methods.description: Includes an external JavaScript file.

methods.name: getXML
methods.description: Returns the constructed XML response.

methods.name: loadXML
methods.description: Loads and appends commands from another response XML.

methods.name: _cmdXML
methods.description: Generates an XML command string from attributes and data.

methods.name: _buildObjXml
methods.description: Serializes a data structure into XML for client-side use.
